name: webrtc-study
description: A small, self-hosted WebRTC study room for video, voice, and chat.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names signaling,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w @round/signaling" "npm run dev -w @round/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @round/protocol && npm run build -w @round/rtc-core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @round/signaling && npm run build -w @round/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @round/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @round/rtc-core && npm run typecheck -w @round/signaling && npm run typecheck -w @round/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @round/protocol && npm run test -w @round/rtc-core && npm run test -w @round/signaling && npm run test -w @round/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
